basis: Anthropic list prices per million tokens. claude-haiku-4-5 read 2026-11-12 (the rates .garak/budget.json carried since D-EV-1); claude-sonnet-5-5 added 2026-11-17 at the list price the owner stated that day, for the product's answers in the Ragas nightly. Prompt caching and batch discounts are not modelled: a cheaper call is never charged below list here, so the meter can only over-count. A price change is a new version of this file, and every record names the table it was priced under by hash.
